verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or community reports describing monday.com's core item/task creation, assignee, or due-date fields — nearly all first-party docs here focus on AI agents/MCP integration rather than basic task management, and community comments only vaguely reference 'items' and 'tickets' without confirming assignment/due-date workflows. missing for 10: docs on creating items with owner/assignee columns, due-date column functionality, and any confirmation of this core PM workflow.
